verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations run cloud agents in the background on a schedule. Schedules use preset options or cron expressions, alongside event triggers from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks and Linear. Automations can be created in plain language via the /automate skill or from Marketplace templates, and Team Owned automations run under a shared service account. Service accounts also document running the CLI in cron jobs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled automations work as documented.
